title: Completion of the counter replay
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $B:\mathbb{Z}\to\{0,1\}\cup\{\text{blank}\}$ be any buffer tape. Starting in the streaming entry state with input head at position zero, counter tape of unary length $n$ with head at zero, buffer tape $B$ with head at zero, and empty output, the intercepted maximum-pass machine reaches the halted configuration after exactly $n+1$ steps. At that point the input head remains at zero, the counter tape is unchanged with its head at $n$, the buffer tape is unchanged with its head at zero, and the output consists of $n$ true bits.
replaced:
Let $x$ be an input, $n \in \mathbb{N}$, and $B$ any buffer tape. Started in the
streaming entry state with the input head at $0$, a unary counter of length $n$
with head at $0$, the buffer $B$ with head at $0$, and empty output, the
intercepted maximum-pass machine after exactly $n + 1$ steps is halted with output
$1^n$ and counter head at $n$, all other fields unchanged; in particular the first
blank after the counter halts the machine without an extra output bit.
